recentItems.title: First UK civilian flies supersonic in USAF F-16 Viper - how did he do?
recentItems.description:
Louis Skupien, the first British civilian to fly in an F-16 Viper, has been describing what it's like to fly in a combat aircraft that goes near-vertical and pulls up to 9G.

He told BFBS Forces News how he had to physically prepare for his high-octane flight through Sidewinder Canyon.
